name: Set Active Hours for Gaming
description: Sets Windows Update active hours to a gaming-friendly time window so the PC is less likely to restart during gameplay, rendering, or streaming sessions.

description_i18n.en: Sets Windows Update active hours to a gaming-friendly time window so the PC is less likely to restart during gameplay, rendering, or streaming sessions.
description_i18n.de: Setzt die aktiven Stunden für Windows-Updates auf ein Zeitfenster zum Spielen, damit der PC seltener während von Gameplay-, Rendering- oder Streaming-Sitzungen neu startet.
description_i18n.fr: Définit les heures d'activité de Windows Update sur une plage adaptée au jeu afin que l'ordinateur ne redémarre pas pendant des sessions de jeu, de rendu ou de streaming.

warnings.title: Policy Override Risk
warnings.message: Enterprise, domain, or MDM policies may override the active hours settings configured by this tweak

compatibility.notes: Uses Windows Update active hours policy values supported on Windows 10 and Windows 11.

technical_details: Configures the registry policy SetActiveHours to enable active hours management and writes ActiveHoursStart/End values based on selected presets Selecting Windows Managed removes these policy values to restore default behavior
